content.short: Ripe is a stablecoin off-ramp for Asia that lets users pay with crypto and settle in local currency.
content.description: Ripe lets people pay and get paid with stablecoins in Asia, even without a bank account. Users connect wallets such as Phantom, OKX or Trust and pay merchants, who receive local currency. Its site names Stable and Plasma among supported stablecoin payment chains, and Plasma's official ecosystem directory lists Ripe.
content.meta: Ripe is a stablecoin off-ramp and payments app for Asia, supporting Plasma and Stable.
